messages:
Asha: weird ask  looking for bedtime music + a short picture-book rec to read aloud to my kid before lights-out. want calm but not sleepy-snooze boring. any combos? 
Ben: for bedtime songs try a soft modern lullaby playlist: Sufjan Stevens (quiet tracks), Nick Drake, and Vashti Bunyan. book rec: 'Because of Winn-Dixie' if you want gentle humor.
Carmen: picture book rec: 'The Quiet Book' by Deborah Underwood  rhythmic and great for voice. pairs with a short harp or piano set.
Devin: tiny playlist I made: https://open.spotify.com/playlist/bedtime-miniEX - 22 minutes of instrumental + soft vocals. title: 'soft tucks & small stories'.
Faye: for something slightly whimsical try Bjf6rk's softer tracks blended with classical guitar. Book: 'Owl Babies' for the toddler crowd.
Gus: quick tip: read the book first once alone so you know where to slow down. helps with dramatic pauses and less stumbling.
Asha: poll: react with :one: for 'Quiet Book' + piano, :two: for Sufjan + 'Because of Winn-Dixie', :three: for Bjf6rk/guitar + 'Owl Babies'.
Ben: :one: from me. rhythm helps kids fall into that sleepy cadence.
Carmen: :three: because Bjf6rk is cozy in small doses.
Devin: made the playlist collaborative and added 2 new lullabies. link updated above.
Faye: tiny props to Gus's read-ahead tip. also add a small ritual: dim lights on page 3 to cue the calm.
Gus: GIF of a sleepy pug being tucked in -> <GIF: sleepy_pug>
Asha: thanks everyone! trying Devin's playlist + 'The Quiet Book' tonight. will report back whether we manage actual bedtime. goodnight. :crescent_moon:
